_comment: Edit this file to set your searches. Each search needs either a pasted Autotrader motorhome-search URL or a criteria block. See README.md for every supported key.

details._comment: Each new advert's page is fetched once to read its features and description. maxFetchesPerRun caps how many per run; delayMs is the pause between requests; adverts whose page says fewer berths than excludeIfBerthBelow are treated as unconverted vans and hidden. refetchTruncated re-reads adverts stored with a cut-short description (up to maxRefetchesPerRun a run) so kit mentioned late in a long blurb is not missed.

deals._comment: wantedSpecs is the star spec: the kit you most want, matched against each advert's page. Every advert is scored out of this list (shown as stars on the dashboard and in notifications). niceToHave is the second tier: each counts one point in the kit score against three per star item. staleNoCutDays flags adverts listed that long with no price cut yet, once the job has watched them for staleNoCutWatchDays (earlier cuts are invisible to it). An advert is 'worth a look' if it has at least minWantedSpecs of them, or its price net of kit is underpricedPercent below similar live adverts, or its desperation score (0-100: price cuts seen up to 60, time listed up to 30, private seller 10) reaches dealScore. A seller counts as motivated at motivatedScore, but only with evidence: a price cut, or a private seller listed longer than staleDays. Any red flag removes it from the list. Labels must match the spec list in src/spec.js (or a top-level 'specs' override).

searches.name: Campervans and van conversions (length from advert)
All motorhomes (star spec research)
searches._comment: Every motorhome, campervan and van conversion on Autotrader in the price and year band, any length or body type, so the star spec can be scored across the whole market. The length rule below only flags these (dashboard toggle), it does not hide them.

length._comment: Overall length in metres. Worked out from Autotrader's spec sheet, a figure stated in the advert, or the base vehicle and wheelbase code (e.g. Ducato L4 = 6.36 m). mode 'hide' takes adverts outside the range off the dashboard (they stay under Hidden by rules); mode 'flag' keeps them all in and gives the dashboard a 'My length only' toggle instead. hideUnknown treats adverts whose length cannot be worked out as outside the range.
